title: Radon V3 — a new chapter, four years in
summary: Version 3.0.0 brings a fresh logo and website, more games, clearer Discord cards, and a stronger moderation toolkit. V3 is in preview; the full launch is planned after Discord intent approval.
changes: Born in February 2022, renewed for the communities here today. The new look comes with player and server guides that explain what to use, when, and how.

More worlds, familiar controls: Solo Leveling: ARISE, Seven Knights Re:BIRTH, and The Seven Deadly Sins: Idle Adventure. Existing accounts and CLAIM buttons keep working. Basic claiming and five saved accounts per game stay free.

Optional voting perks: a verified vote unlocks a fixed 24-hour Supporter Pass with ten accounts per game and opt-in alerts for future staff-posted coupons. Voting is never required for basic claiming.

A clearer Discord experience: consistent cards, contextual /help, /guide, and private claim-progress feedback. Saved accounts and duplicate-redemption protection help avoid repeat work; publisher delays can still affect speed.
More context for moderators: /case history, staff notes, reason-edit history, and private message reports. Warnings, severity thresholds, and editable mod logs still have their own jobs.

More control over safety: opt-in AutoMod presets, flood and link rules, and join-burst response. Start in observe mode. Custom message and join features require the relevant Discord access and operator configuration; they are not enabled by this release.

Better recovery: restorable timed locks, persistent temporary-ban schedules, stronger permission checks, and warning updates protected against concurrent writes. Scheduled actions can run late after downtime.
An easier start: /setup start walks through roles, logs and reports, optional observation, then review and save. /setup view shows saved choices; /doctor provides private, read-only readiness checks.

A direct line for feedback: /bug saves private bot reports for the owner. /updates and the website share this release history. Full V3 launch is planned after intent approval; no launch date or approval is promised.

title: A direct line for bugs, and a place for updates
summary: Report a problem privately and keep up with what changes in Radon.
changes: Use /bug to send a bug report directly to Radon's owner. Reports are saved privately, with a reference you can keep.
Spam, false reports, and abuse will lead to a ban from using the bot. Never include passwords, tokens, or private account codes in a report.
Use /updates to read the latest changes, or choose an older update with the release option. The website now has the same update history.
The website has smoother motion, clearer navigation on guide and legal pages, and improved search and sharing metadata.

title: More games, optional vote rewards, and clearer guides
summary: The same claiming workflow now supports three games, with optional extras for supporters.
changes: Claim coupons for Solo Leveling: ARISE, Seven Knights Re:BIRTH, and The Seven Deadly Sins: Idle Adventure. Existing Solo Leveling accounts and CLAIM buttons keep working.
A verified vote on either Top.gg or Discord Bot List unlocks a 24-hour Supporter Pass: ten saved accounts per game and optional coupon alerts. Free claiming and five saved accounts remain available.
Use /guide for claiming, voting, troubleshooting, moderation cases, and AutoMod. Command replies now use clearer cards and private staff views.
